description:
-= Shower =-
You've entered a shower. You start to take note of what's in the room.

You can see a locked drawer.

You need an unguarded exit? You should try going east. You need an unblocked exit? You should try going north.
objective: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to go to the east. Next, close the safe inside the bedchamber. Alright, thanks!
